response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and exposure to AI-agent tooling, but lacks clear evidence of cloud/AI platform leadership, strategic product impact at scale, or advanced AI credentials required for a director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive with open-source AI-adjacent platform (GISCollective)
Broad technical fluency across languages, cloud tools (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes), and systems design
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and share knowledge through workshops and open-source contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of building or shipping AI-powered products or platforms at scale
Lacks documented leadership in cloud AI strategy or direct experience advising enterprise customers on AI adoption
No advanced degree in AI or related field; 15-year experience is present but not clearly focused on AI/cloud strategy
